$comment: Stills and loops for the website, cut from the in-engine captures in 'Marketing Materials'. Times are seconds into the source clip. The shot list follows the 3.5 showcase edit (v3.5/showcase_5min/beats.py). Build with: node tools/media/build.mjs

crops.$comment: x, y, w, h in the 2560x1440 captures. hud drops the demo HUD panel; bay frames a Feature Examples display; proof keeps the FPS counter beside the debug view.

stills.alt: A swarm of drones pours between brick towers in the LCM 3D Navigation AI City demo for Unreal Engine 5
stills.caption: A Mass drone swarm threading the City open world.

stills.alt: Close view of a Mass Entity drone swarm flying through a city in Unreal Engine 5
stills.caption: Close fly-through of the swarm: every drone on its own 6-DOF body.

stills.alt: A drone swarm sweeping over a city skyline, driven by a shared 3D flow field
stills.caption: One shared flow field carries the whole swarm over the skyline.

stills.alt: A crowd of drones rising floor by floor through a skyscraper in Unreal Engine 5
stills.caption: Vertical navigation: a swarm climbing through a tower.

stills.alt: A flock of birds threads a series of rings above a forest using true 3D pathfinding
stills.caption: A bird flock threading the rings over the forest.

stills.alt: Close-up of the Hunter Drone with its glowing sensor eye in the LCM 3D Navigation AI demo
stills.caption: Hunter Drone: Engage Target with prediction and a clean line of fire.

stills.alt: Hunter drones weave between shipping container stacks while chasing a runner
stills.caption: Hunters weave between container stacks on real 3D routes.

stills.alt: A hunter drone flies its engagement path around a container stack in Unreal Engine 5
stills.caption: Engage Target picks a firing position and flies to it.

stills.alt: A courier drone descends and lands on the deck of a moving, rolling ship in the Harbour demo
stills.caption: Land on a moving deck: the approach is flown relative to the rolling ship.

stills.alt: A drone lands on the flatbed of a moving lorry on the harbour quay
stills.caption: The same Land task puts a drone down on a moving lorry.

stills.alt: Close-up of a quadcopter drone hovering over the harbour quay in Unreal Engine 5
stills.caption: Multirotor flight dynamics: thrust, drag and attitude control.

stills.alt: Sentry drones patrol a depot with the navigation octree and AI Perception sight cones drawn
stills.caption: Sentry Drones: AI Perception sight cones and EQS firing positions.

stills.alt: A security drone flies the length of a warehouse aisle between tall racking
stills.caption: Warehouse: perch, scan, engage, investigate and flee indoors.

stills.alt: A drone crosses the archive hall of the warehouse demo level
stills.caption: Interior navigation through the archive hall.

stills.alt: A seagull glides along sea cliffs in the Sea Cliffs demo of LCM 3D Navigation AI
stills.caption: 6-DOF gulls glide; they cannot hover.

stills.alt: Seagulls sweep in and one lands to perch on a sea stack ledge
stills.caption: Perch: gulls glide in and settle on free cliff ledges.

stills.alt: The live sparse voxel octree drawn around a sea stack, with the frame-rate counter in view
stills.caption: The live octree around the sea stack, captured in real time.

stills.alt: Tropical fish swim over a coral reef using volumetric navigation in Unreal Engine 5
stills.caption: Coral Reef: fish use the whole water column.

stills.alt: Angelfish swimming above the reef in the Coral Reef demo
stills.caption: Undulatory fish locomotion over the reef.

stills.alt: A Mass Entity school of fish streams over the coral, parting round the pinnacles
stills.caption: Reef School: a Mass school follows its leader on the flow field.

stills.alt: A large school of fish turning together above the reef in Unreal Engine 5
stills.caption: Schooling: personal space, heading matching and turning off rocks.

stills.alt: A 120 cm aquarium navigated at 1 cm voxels, with small fish swimming through a rock arch
stills.caption: Fish Tank: a 120 cm aquarium navigated at 1 cm.

stills.alt: Close-up of 8 cm fish in the Fish Tank small-world demo
stills.caption: 8 cm fish at small-world scale.

stills.alt: The 1 cm fish tank running in real time in Unreal Engine 5, with the frame-rate counter in view
stills.caption: The 1 cm fish tank, captured in real time with the frame counter in view.

stills.alt: Starfighters exchange laser fire in the Space Dogfight demo for Unreal Engine 5
stills.caption: Space Dogfight: lead intercept through a streamed asteroid belt.

stills.alt: A fighter leads its target with laser fire between asteroids
stills.caption: Fly To in chase mode re-plans through the octree as the target breaks.

stills.alt: A pursuit past bright asteroids in a streamed space level
stills.caption: No floor, no up, no walls: 6-DOF pursuit.

stills.alt: A fleet of ships flies through a drifting asteroid field in the Deep Space open world
stills.caption: Deep Space: an asteroid field streamed around the fleet.

stills.alt: Drones and their planned routes drawn over a city open world in Unreal Engine 5
stills.caption: City open world: routes planned through streamed chunks.

stills.alt: The streamed octree and agent routes over the city, with chunk boundaries visible
stills.caption: The octree and routes over the city, chunk by chunk.

stills.alt: Flight routes over a forest canopy towards a rocky massif in the Forest open world
stills.caption: Forest: canopy, clearings and tunnels through rock.

stills.alt: Cost areas priced across streamed chunk seams in a 3D navigation demo
stills.caption: Cost areas hold across streamed chunk seams.

stills.alt: The Fly To Location Blueprint node demonstrated in the Movement Nodes Feature Examples level
stills.caption: Fly To Location: one Blueprint node, no AI Controller.

stills.alt: A drone runs the Patrol task between waypoints in the Feature Examples hall
stills.caption: Patrol: routes between waypoints, BT and StateTree.

stills.alt: A drone circles a pillar with the Orbit Target task
stills.caption: Orbit Target, at a set radius and speed.

stills.alt: The Engage Target behaviour node choosing a firing position with line of sight
stills.caption: Engage Target: a firing position that keeps line of sight.

stills.alt: Three follower drones hold formation slots behind a leader with the Follow Target task
stills.caption: Follow Target: followers hold their slots in the leader's frame.

stills.alt: Drones sweep a volume with the Scan Area behaviour node
stills.caption: Scan Area: a volume swept from shared viewpoints.

stills.alt: Three drones land on three posts with the Perch node, never on the same one
stills.caption: Perch: tagged ledges and pads, no two agents on one.

stills.alt: A drone lands on a moving platform with the Land task
stills.caption: Land on a moving platform.

stills.alt: A true 3D EQS generator drawing scored candidate points throughout a navigation volume
stills.caption: EQS in true 3D: candidate points anywhere in the volume.

stills.alt: The Reachability 3D EQS test colouring points an agent can and cannot reach
stills.caption: Reachability 3D, answered before any search.

stills.alt: A drone route bends around a storm cost area in the Cost Areas Feature Examples level
stills.caption: A storm cost area: the route bends round it.

stills.alt: A drone follows a cheaper preferred lane cost area in Unreal Engine 5
stills.caption: A preferred lane: the planner picks the cheaper corridor.
